category: 工業區位的轉變/Changing industrial location
questionText:
公司 K 是一家總部設於國家 P（已發展國家）的智能手機公司。2015 年，公司把組裝廠房由國家 Q 遷往國家 R（欠發達國家），研發部門則留在國家 P。參考以上資料，回答第 11 題及第 12 題。
以下哪些可能是公司 K 把組裝廠房遷往國家 R 的原因？
(1) 國家 R 的工資較低。
(2) 國家 R 政府為外資提供稅務優惠。
(3) 國家 R 鄰近鐵礦等原料產地。
Company K is a smartphone company headquartered in Country P (a developed country). In 2015 it relocated its assembly plant from Country Q to Country R (a less developed country), while its research and development (R&D) department remained in Country P. Refer to the information and answer Q11 and Q12.
Which of the following are possible reasons for Company K to relocate its assembly plant to Country R?
(1) Wages in Country R are lower.
(2) The government of Country R offers tax incentives to foreign investors.
(3) Country R is near sources of raw materials such as iron ore.

category: 建設一個可持續發展的城市/Building a sustainable city
questionText:
以下哪一項規劃措施最能幫助新市鎮達至「自給自足」？
Which of the following planning measures would best help a new town to become self-contained?

options.A:
興建鐵路連接新市鎮與商業中心區
Building a railway linking the new town with the CBD
options.B:
在新市鎮外圍劃設綠化地帶
Designating a green belt around the new town
options.C:
提高新市鎮住宅的建築密度
Raising the building density of housing in the new town
options.D:
在新市鎮內提供就業機會及社區設施
Providing job opportunities and community facilities within the new town

category: 建設一個可持續發展的城市/Building a sustainable city
questionText:
以下哪些是高密度發展有助城市可持續發展的原因？
(1) 縮短通勤距離，減少交通運輸的能源消耗。
(2) 減少城市蔓延，保留較多郊野土地。
(3) 必定改善街道層面的空氣質素。
Which of the following are reasons why high-density development can help a city to develop sustainably?
(1) It shortens commuting distances and reduces energy consumption for transport.
(2) It reduces urban sprawl and preserves more countryside.
(3) It must improve air quality at street level.
